scenario.scenario_text: You are an outstanding undergraduate planning to apply to a prestigious Master's program in Applied Linguistics at the University of Edinburgh. You need a strong recommendation letter from Professor Smith, who taught you in two courses (ENGL 401 Advanced Linguistics in Fall 2024, and ENGL 412 Sociolinguistics in Spring 2025) and supervised your undergraduate thesis. The application deadline is in 6 weeks. Write a highly professional academic email requesting the recommendation.
requirements: Re-establish your academic identity with precise course details (codes + semesters)
Articulate why this specific professor is uniquely qualified to recommend you
Use diplomatic hedging language (e.g., 'whether you would be willing')
Provide a face-saving option ('I completely understand if...')
Organize logistical info clearly (deadline, submission method, materials)
Close with sincere appreciation and acknowledgment of past guidance

coach_content.step1_situation_ar: هذا موقف يتطلب أعلى مستوى من الـ academic register. عليك تذكير الأستاذ بسياقك الأكاديمي بدقة (المواد، الدرجات، البحث)، تخصيص الطلب (لماذا هذا الأستاذ بالذات)، استخدام صيغ دبلوماسية، وتقديم 'face-saving option' بأن تتيح للأستاذ رفض الطلب بأدب.
coach_content.step1_situation_en: You are an outstanding undergraduate applying to a prestigious MA program. You need a strong recommendation letter from a professor who taught you in two courses and supervised your thesis. The deadline is in 6 weeks. Write a highly professional academic email.
coach_content.step1_tone_ar: احترافي أكاديمي رفيع جداً — يجمع بين الاحترام العميق، الدقة الأكاديمية، والدبلوماسية. لا مكان للمجاملات العاطفية أو الضغط الزمني.

step1_goals_json.en: Re-establish your academic identity with precision
step1_goals_json.tip_ar: اذكر اسمك الكامل، رمز المادة + اسمها + الفصل (مثل: ENGL 401 Fall 2024)، الإشراف على البحث. تجنب 'last year' الغامضة.

step1_goals_json.en: Personalize the request to this specific professor
step1_goals_json.tip_ar: اربط بين تخصص الأستاذ والبرنامج المستهدف. مثال: 'Given your expertise in sociolinguistic methodology...'

step1_goals_json.ar: تقديم طلب دبلوماسي مع خيار الرفض المحفوظ للكرامة
step1_goals_json.en: Make a diplomatic request with a face-saving exit option
step1_goals_json.tip_ar: استخدم 'whether you would be willing' بدلاً من 'can you'، وأضف 'I completely understand if...' للحفاظ على العلاقة.

step2_structure_json.purpose_ar: عنوان دقيق يلخص الطلب مع الموعد النهائي
step2_structure_json.example_en: Recommendation Letter Request — Ahmed Al-Yemeni, MA Application (Deadline: 30 June 2026)
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: Tier 90: ضع اسمك والموعد في العنوان — يساعد الأستاذ في تنظيم الأولويات.

step2_structure_json.purpose_ar: تحية رسمية مع اللقب الأكاديمي الصحيح
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: لا تستخدم 'Hi' أبداً. استخدم 'Professor' (افتراضياً) أو 'Dr.' إذا فضّل ذلك.

step2_structure_json.example_en: I hope this message finds you well. My name is Ahmed Al-Yemeni, and I had the privilege of being your student in ENGL 401 (Advanced Linguistics, Fall 2024) and ENGL 412 (Sociolinguistics, Spring 2025), in addition to working under your supervision on my undergraduate thesis.
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: ادمج: تحية + اسم كامل + مواد محددة + بحث/إشراف. هذا يظهر احتراماً لوقت الأستاذ.

step2_structure_json.purpose_ar: طلب التوصية بصياغة دبلوماسية مع التخصيص
step2_structure_json.example_en: I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to write a letter of recommendation in support of my application to the MA program in Applied Linguistics at the University of Edinburgh. Given your expertise in sociolinguistic methodology and your familiarity with my academic work, a letter from you would carry exceptional weight.
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: 'whether you would be willing' = دبلوماسي / 'Given your expertise' = تخصيص / 'exceptional weight' = تقدير مهني.

step2_structure_json.example_en: The application deadline is 30 June 2026, giving us approximately six weeks. Should you agree, I would be glad to provide: (1) my updated CV, (2) a draft of my personal statement, (3) my academic transcripts, and (4) a brief summary of the program requirements. The recommendation can be submitted directly through the university's online portal — I will send you the secure link once you confirm.
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: قائمة مرقمة + 'us' بدلاً من 'you' = شراكة / تحديد طريقة التقديم يقلل العبء.

step2_structure_json.purpose_ar: ترك خيار الرفض بأدب + اعتراف بالفضل + خاتمة رسمية
step2_structure_json.example_en:
I completely understand if your current commitments do not allow for this, and I am deeply grateful for the guidance you have already provided throughout my undergraduate studies. I look forward to your response at your convenience.

With sincere appreciation,
Ahmed Al-Yemeni
step2_structure_json.tip_ar: العناصر الذهبية: face-saving + اعتراف بالجميل + 'at your convenience' + خاتمة أكاديمية رسمية.

coach_content.step4_model_email:
Dear Professor Smith,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Ahmed Al-Yemeni, and I had the privilege of being your student in ENGL 401 (Advanced Linguistics, Fall 2024) and ENGL 412 (Sociolinguistics, Spring 2025), in addition to working under your supervision on my undergraduate thesis on language attitudes in multilingual communities.

I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to write a letter of recommendation in support of my application to the MA program in Applied Linguistics at the University of Edinburgh. Given your expertise in sociolinguistic methodology and your familiarity with my academic work, a letter from you would carry exceptional weight in my application.

The application deadline is 30 June 2026, giving us approximately six weeks. Should you agree, I would be glad to provide: (1) my updated CV, (2) a draft of my personal statement, (3) my academic transcripts, and (4) a brief summary of the program requirements. The recommendation can be submitted directly through the university's online portal, and I will send you the secure link once you confirm.

I completely understand if your current commitments do not allow for this, and I am deeply grateful for the guidance you have already provided throughout my undergraduate studies. I look forward to your response at your convenience.

With sincere appreciation,
Ahmed Al-Yemeni
Student ID: 20210456
ahmed.alyemeni@university.edu

step6_checklist_json.item_ar: هل بدأت بـ 'Dear Professor [Last Name],' وليس 'Hi'؟
هل ذكرت اسمك الكامل في الفقرة الأولى؟
هل ذكرت المواد بدقة (رمز + اسم + فصل)؟
هل ذكرت اسم البرنامج والجامعة المستهدفة؟
هل استخدمت 'whether you would be willing' بدلاً من 'can you'؟
هل وضحت لماذا هذا الأستاذ بالذات (تخصصه، إلمامه بعملك)؟
هل ذكرت الموعد النهائي بصيغة واضحة (تاريخ + عدد الأسابيع)؟
هل قدمت قائمة مرقمة بالمواد التي ستوفرها؟
هل أضفت face-saving sentence ('I completely understand if...')؟
هل ختمت بـ 'With sincere appreciation' أو ما يماثلها؟

common_mistakes_json.correct_en: Dear Professor [Last Name], I hope this message finds you well.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ 'Hi' غير رسمية. ✅ 'Dear Professor' هو المعيار الذهبي.

common_mistakes_json.wrong_en: Can you write me a recommendation letter?
common_mistakes_json.correct_en: I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to write a letter of recommendation.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ 'Can you' مباشرة وتفترض الموافقة. ✅ صياغة دبلوماسية تعطي خيار الرفض.

common_mistakes_json.wrong_en: I need this letter by June 30. Please send it soon.
common_mistakes_json.correct_en: The application deadline is 30 June 2026, giving us approximately six weeks.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ 'I need' و 'please send it soon' يضعان ضغطاً غير مهذب. ✅ صياغة محايدة مع 'us'.

common_mistakes_json.correct_en: Given your expertise in [field], a letter from you would carry exceptional weight.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ مجاملة عاطفية غير مهنية. ✅ تقدير مهني محدد بالتخصص.

common_mistakes_json.wrong_en: I took your class last year.
common_mistakes_json.correct_en: I was your student in ENGL 401 (Advanced Linguistics, Fall 2024).
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ غامض — يجبر الأستاذ على التخمين. ✅ دقة أكاديمية.

common_mistakes_json.correct_en: I completely understand if your current commitments do not allow for this.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ ضغط عاطفي. ✅ Face-saving option كاملة الاحتراف.

common_mistakes_json.correct_en: I look forward to your response at your convenience.
common_mistakes_json.explanation_ar: ❌ 'ASAP' وقحة. ✅ 'at your convenience' تحترم وقت الأستاذ.
